subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers replace the open conflicting fork PR with a narrow current-main Telegram fix, or adopt and rebase that fork branch first?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but GitHub still has an open closing PR that is conflicting, edits an obsolete handler path, and includes unrelated docs churn, so automation should pause until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Main Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with real Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase Fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to rework the existing fork PR onto the current runtime file and strip unrelated docs changes.

options.title: Keep Waiting On Fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the conflicting fork branch, accepting that no clean current-main fix is moving yet.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Main Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-file and shared-runtime history makes this the best available routing owner for the landing-path decision.
